question:
**Direction: Identify the idiom or phrase that can best substitute the underlined segment.**

You showed me your **__true personality__** when you asked me to get out of the house at midnight.
solution:
The correct answer is "true colours."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The phrase **"true colors" **refers to a person's real or genuine character, often implying that the person's behavior or personality becomes apparent, especially in challenging or difficult situations. (किसी व्यक्ति का वास्तविक चरित्र, जिसका अर्थ अक्सर यह होता है कि व्यक्ति का व्यवहार या व्यक्तित्व स्पष्ट हो जाता है, विशेष रूप से चुनौतीपूर्ण या कठिन परिस्थितियों में)

 
 
• **Example**: *During the crisis, his **true colors**__ emerged, revealing a compassionate and reliable nature.*
 
 
 
• It suggests that someone's true nature, beliefs, or intentions are revealed when they are under pressure or faced with adversity.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bed of roses: **to describe a situation or circumstance that is comfortable, easy, or pleasant. (किसी ऐसी स्थिति या परिस्थिति का वर्णन करना जो आरामदायक, आसान या सुखद हो)
 
• **Hot potato: **refers to a sensitive or controversial issue that is difficult to handle and causes discomfort. (एक संवेदनशील या विवादास्पद मुद्दे को संदर्भित करता है जिसे संभालना मुश्किल है और असुविधा का कारण बनता है)
 
• **White elephant: **to describe an expensive and burdensome possession or project, especially one that is difficult to maintain or dispose of. (किसी महँगे और बोझिल कब्जे या परियोजना का वर्णन करना, विशेष रूप से वह जिसका रखरखाव या निपटान करना कठिन हो)
